id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

width.description: The width of the chart component. Leave blank to use the default width.

height.description: The height of the chart component. Leave blank to use the default height.

dataStoreId.description:
The data store ID that provides data for the chart. The datastore should be a {@link UiApDataStore} that provides
data for the chart. It should have two {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap} entries:
- `chartConfig` - The action to fetch the {@link UiApTimeseriesChartConfig}
- `renderConfig` - The action to fetch the {@link UiApTimeseriesChartRenderConfig}. Overrides parts of
the `chartConfig`.

header.description:
The title to display for the chart.

It accepts the following properties:
- `title`: As a string or a {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpec} object.
- `subtitle`: As a string or a {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpec} object.

toolbarOptions.description:
The toolbar options to display in the chart.
It can modify the following toolbar options:

- `disableLinesButtons`: If true, the horizontal/vertical lines buttons will not be displayed.
- `disableSplitMergeButton`: If true, the split/unsplit button will not be displayed.
- `disableZoomButtons`: If true, the zoom area and zoom mouse buttons will not be displayed.
- `customButtons`: Optional array of custom buttons to render at the end of the toolbar. Each item supports:
  - `icon`: Icon class for the button (e.g. 'refresh').
  - `text`: The translation key for the button text. If provided, button renders as icon-with-text.
  - `tooltip`: The translation key for the button tooltip.
  - `usage`: Optional SDLButton usage override; defaults to 'icon' or 'icon-with-text' based on `text`.
  - `actionSuffix`: The suffix appended to the chart `dataStoreId` to form the Redux action type on click.

showLoadingIndicator.description:
Flags whether the chart should display a loading indicator while data is being fetched.

- When true, a loading spinner will be shown until the data is fully loaded. (Uses #dataStoreId `DATA_REQUEST` and
 `DATA_RECEIVE` events.)
- When false, no loading indicator will be shown, and the user will need to handle the spinner externally.

splitButtonText.description: The text to display on the split button.

unsplitButtonText.description: The text to display on the unsplit button.

emptyStateConfig.description: Configuration for the empty state when no data is available.

chartConfig.description: Determines the data to be displayed in the chart, and how it is displayed.

layoutConfig.description:
Layout configuration for chart margins, plot sizing, legend, y-axis, labels, and tooltips.
If not provided, default layout settings will be used.

title: A React component that renders a timeseries chart.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartReact
